approval.identityRecord: Retained by the owner outside this public repository.

authorization.deployment: Authorized for the four-person internal production preview dogfood after the required reviews and npm run verify:release complete.
authorization.postDeployProof: Immediately after deployment, run an authenticated remote proof of Computer persistence across a Worker restart and owner isolation.
authorization.failureAction: If the authenticated remote persistence or isolation proof fails, roll back to the recorded prior Worker version.

constraints: Computer remains a separate owner-scoped file-only preview filesystem.
Computer has no execution backend and no automatic sync with Workspace.
Per-work_code Computer budgets and per-owner file and storage quotas remain enabled.
The authenticated remote persistence and isolation proof is required immediately after deployment.

review.trigger: Review on or before 2026-09-04, or before the next release, whichever comes first.

rollback.priorVersionCapture: Before any preview deployment, record the immediately preceding Worker deployment version ID and git revision in the private deployment record.
rollback.action: On authenticated remote persistence or isolation proof failure, use Worker deployment history to activate the recorded immediately preceding version.
rollback.postRollbackProof: Verify the prior version is active and rerun its authenticated production journey.
rollback.escalation: Stop the preview and notify the owner if the prior version cannot be activated or its proof fails.
